hosted on [GitHub](https://github.com/LasaiBarrenada) and

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/html/software.css">

<div id="sw-container">
<div id="sw-loading">
<div class="sw-spinner"></div>
<p>Loading repositories from GitHub…</p>
</div>
<div id="sw-grid" class="sw-grid"></div>
<div id="sw-error" style="display:none;"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  /* ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var USERNAME      = 'LasaiBarrenada';
  var EXCLUDE_REPOS = [
    'LasaiBarrenada.github.io', 'LasaiBarrenada', 'web_resources',
    'quarto_mc_template', 'academicpages.github.io',
    'BD_Colegios_Email', 'Disenos-de-registro', 'NTTS2021_Hackathon_UCM'
  ];

  /* GitHub language colours (most common in academic work) */
  var LANG_COLORS = {
    'R':                '#198CE7',
    'Python':           '#3572A5',
    'JavaScript':       '#f1e05a',
    'TypeScript':       '#3178c6',
    'HTML':             '#e34c26',
    'CSS':              '#563d7c',
    'TeX':              '#3D6117',
    'Shell':            '#89e051',
    'Jupyter Notebook': '#DA5B0B',
    'C++':              '#f34b7d',
    'C':                '#555555',
    'Stata':            '#1a5f91',
    'SAS':              '#B34936',
    'MATLAB':           '#e16737'
  };

  /* ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function timeAgo(dateStr) {
    var seconds = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 1000);
    var intervals = [
      { label: 'year',  s: 31536000 },
      { label: 'month', s: 2592000  },
      { label: 'week',  s: 604800   },
      { label: 'day',   s: 86400    },
      { label: 'hour',  s: 3600     }
    ];
    for (var i = 0; i < intervals.length; i++) {
      var count = Math.floor(seconds / intervals[i].s);
      if (count >= 1) return count + ' ' + intervals[i].label + (count > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' ago';
    }
    return 'just now';
  }

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.textContent = str;
    return div.innerHTML;
  }

  /* Repos the user contributes to but doesn't own (upstream owner/repo).
     These are fetched individually and shown with a "Contributor" badge. */
  var CONTRIB_REPOS = [
    'BavoDC/CalibrationCurves',
    'thomas-sounack/TRIPOD-Code',
    'benvancalster/PerfMeasuresOverview',
  ];

  /* ── Build a single card ────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildCard(repo, isContrib) {
    var langHtml = '';
    if (repo.language) {
      var col = LANG_COLORS[repo.language] || '#999';
      langHtml = '<span class="sw-lang">' +
        '<span class="sw-lang-dot" style="background:' + col + '"></span>' +
        '<span class="sw-lang-name">' + escapeHtml(repo.language) + '</span>' +
        '</span>';
    }

    var starsHtml = repo.stargazers_count > 0
      ? '<span class="sw-stars">\u2B50 ' + repo.stargazers_count + '</span>'
      : '';

    var badgeHtml = isContrib
      ? '<span class="sw-contrib-badge">Contributor</span>\n'
      : '';

    var desc = repo.description
      ? escapeHtml(repo.description)
      : '<em>No description provided.</em>';

    var topicsHtml = '';
    if (repo.topics && repo.topics.length > 0) {
      topicsHtml = '<div class="sw-topics">' +
        repo.topics.map(function (t) {
          return '<span class="sw-topic">' + escapeHtml(t) + '</span>';
        }).join('') +
        '</div>';
    }

    return '<div class="sw-card">' +
      '<div class="sw-card-header">' +
        '<a href="' + repo.html_url + '" target="_blank" class="sw-repo-name">' +
          escapeHtml(repo.full_name || repo.name) + '</a>' +
        starsHtml +
      '</div>' +
      badgeHtml +
      '<p class="sw-card-desc">' + desc + '</p>' +
      topicsHtml +
      '<div class="sw-card-meta">' +
        langHtml +
        '<span class="sw-updated">Updated ' + timeAgo(repo.pushed_at) + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  /* ── Fetch helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var API = 'https://api.github.com';
  var HEADERS = { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json' };

  function fetchJSON(url) {
    return fetch(url, { headers: HEADERS }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
      return res.json();
    });
  }

  /* ── Fetch owned repos + contributed repos, then render ─────── */
  Promise.all([
    fetchJSON(API + '/users/' + USERNAME + '/repos?type=owner&sort=pushed&per_page=100'),
    Promise.all(CONTRIB_REPOS.map(function (slug) {
      return fetchJSON(API + '/repos/' + slug).catch(function () { return null; });
    }))
  ])
  .then(function (results) {
    document.getElementById('sw-loading').style.display = 'none';

    /* Own repos: exclude forks, archived, and blacklisted */
    var owned = results[0].filter(function (r) {
      return !r.fork && !r.archived && EXCLUDE_REPOS.indexOf(r.name) === -1;
    });

    /* Contributed repos: drop any that failed to fetch */
    var contrib = results[1].filter(function (r) { return r !== null && !r.archived; });

    var all = owned.map(function (r) { return { repo: r, contrib: false }; })
      .concat(contrib.map(function (r) { return { repo: r, contrib: true }; }));

    all.sort(function (a, b) { return b.repo.stargazers_count - a.repo.stargazers_count; });

    var cards = all.map(function (d) { return buildCard(d.repo, d.contrib); });

    if (cards.length === 0) {
      document.getElementById('sw-grid').innerHTML =
        '<p>No public repositories found.</p>';
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById('sw-grid').innerHTML = cards.join('');
  })
  .catch(function (err) {
    document.getElementById('sw-loading').style.display = 'none';
    var el = document.getElementById('sw-error');
    el.style.display = 'block';
    console.error('GitHub repos fetch failed:', err);
    var isRateLimit = err && err.message && err.message.indexOf('403') !== -1;
    el.innerHTML = isRateLimit
      ? '<p>GitHub API rate limit reached &mdash; please try again in a few minutes.</p>'
        + '<p><a href="https://github.com/' + USERNAME + '" target="_blank">'
        + 'View my repositories on GitHub \u2192</a></p>'
      : '<p>Could not load repositories from GitHub.</p>'
        + '<p><a href="https://github.com/' + USERNAME + '" target="_blank">'
        + 'View my repositories on GitHub \u2192</a></p>';
  });
})();
</script>

```

```{r}
#| label: osf-projects
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat('<h2 class="sw-section-heading">OSF Projects</h2>\n')
cat('<div class="sw-grid" id="osf-grid">\n')

library(jsonlite)
library(openxlsx)

# Read projects spreadsheet for paper links (matched via OSF_ID column)
proj_df <- tryCatch(
  read.xlsx("../projects/projects.xlsx"),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}


format_date <- function(date_str) {
  d <- as.POSIXct(date_str, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC")
  format(d, "%b %Y")
}

# Extra papers for OSF projects NOT in projects.xlsx.
# Add entries as: "osf_node_id" = list(list(title = "...", url = "..."), ...)
osf_extra_papers <- list(
  "pyv38" = list(list(title = "Artificial Intelligence Applied to Ultrasound Diagnosis of Pelvic Gynecological Tumors: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis", url = "https://doi.org/10.1159/000545850")),
    "jtsvd" = list(list(title = "Head-to-head comparison of the RMI and ADNEX models to estimate the risk of ovarian malignancy: a systematic review and meta-analysis of external validation studies", url = "https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjopen-2025-104141"))
)

cat_labels <- c(
  "project" = "Project", "data" = "Data", "software" = "Software",
  "methods and measures" = "Methods", "other" = "Other"
)

cat_icons <- c(
  "project" = "&#128193;", "data" = "&#128202;", "software" = "&#128187;",
  "methods and measures" = "&#128296;", "other" = "&#128194;"
)

fetch_children <- function(node_id) {
  tryCatch(
    fromJSON(
      sprintf("https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/%s/children/?format=json&page%%5Bsize%%5D=100",
              node_id),
      simplifyVector = FALSE
    )$data,
    error = function(e) list()
  )
}

osf_raw <- tryCatch(
  fromJSON(
    "https://api.osf.io/v2/users/pgkjv/nodes/?format=json&page%5Bsize%5D=100",
    simplifyVector = FALSE
  ),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (!is.null(osf_raw) && length(osf_raw$data) > 0) {
  nodes <- osf_raw$data

  # Keep only top-level public projects (root id == node id)
  nodes <- Filter(function(n) {
    root_id <- n$relationships$root$data$id
    !is.null(root_id) && root_id == n$id && isTRUE(n$attributes$public)
  }, nodes)

  # Sort by date_created descending, but display date_modified on the card
  created_dates <- vapply(nodes, function(n) n$attributes$date_created, "")
  nodes <- nodes[order(created_dates, decreasing = TRUE)]

  for (n in nodes) {
    a   <- n$attributes
    url <- n$links$html
    ttl <- esc(a$title)

    desc <- if (!is.null(a$description) && nzchar(a$description)) {
      esc(a$description)
    } else {
      "<em>No description provided.</em>"
    }

    cat_lbl <- if (!is.null(a$category) && a$category %in% names(cat_labels)) {
      cat_labels[a$category]
    } else ""
    cat_html <- if (nzchar(cat_lbl)) {
      sprintf(' <span class="sw-osf-category">%s</span>', esc(cat_lbl))
    } else ""

    tags_html <- ""
    if (!is.null(a$tags) && length(a$tags) > 0) {
      spans <- vapply(a$tags, function(t) {
        sprintf('<span class="sw-topic sw-topic-osf">%s</span>', esc(t))
      }, "")
      tags_html <- sprintf('<div class="sw-topics">%s</div>', paste(spans, collapse = ""))
    }

    # Look up related paper(s): first from projects.xlsx, then extras
    all_paper_links <- character(0)

    if (!is.null(proj_df) && "OSF_ID" %in% names(proj_df)) {
      matches <- proj_df[which(proj_df$OSF_ID == n$id), , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(matches) > 0) {
        all_paper_links <- c(all_paper_links, vapply(seq_len(nrow(matches)), function(i) {
          row <- matches[i, ]
          if (!is.na(row$Link_1) && !is.na(row$Title)) {
            sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" class="sw-paper-link" title="%s">&#128196; %s</a>',
                    esc(row$Link_1), esc(row$Title), esc(row$Title))
          } else ""
        }, ""))
      }
    }

    if (n$id %in% names(osf_extra_papers)) {
      for (p in osf_extra_papers[[n$id]]) {
        all_paper_links <- c(all_paper_links,
          sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" class="sw-paper-link" title="%s">&#128196; %s</a>',
                  esc(p$url), esc(p$title), esc(p$title)))
      }
    }

    all_paper_links <- all_paper_links[nzchar(all_paper_links)]
    paper_html <- if (length(all_paper_links) > 0) {
      sprintf('<div class="sw-papers">%s</div>', paste(all_paper_links, collapse = "\n"))
    } else ""

    # Fetch and render child components
    children <- fetch_children(n$id)
    children_html <- ""
    if (length(children) > 0) {
      child_items <- vapply(children, function(ch) {
        ch_title <- esc(ch$attributes$title)
        ch_url   <- ch$links$html
        ch_cat   <- if (!is.null(ch$attributes$category)) ch$attributes$category else "other"
        icon     <- if (ch_cat %in% names(cat_icons)) cat_icons[ch_cat] else "&#128194;"
        lbl      <- if (ch_cat %in% names(cat_labels)) cat_labels[ch_cat] else ch_cat
        sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank" class="sw-child-link">%s %s <span class="sw-child-cat">%s</span></a>',
          ch_url, icon, ch_title, esc(lbl)
        )
      }, "")
      children_html <- sprintf(
        '<div class="sw-children"><span class="sw-children-label">Components</span>%s</div>',
        paste(child_items, collapse = "\n")
      )
    }

    cat(sprintf(
'<div class="sw-card sw-card-osf">
<div class="sw-card-header">
<a href="%s" target="_blank" class="sw-repo-name">%s</a>
</div>
<span class="sw-osf-badge">OSF</span>%s
<p class="sw-card-desc">%s</p>
%s
%s
%s
<div class="sw-card-meta">
<span class="sw-updated">Updated %s</span>
</div>
</div>\n',
      url, ttl, cat_html, desc, tags_html, paper_html, children_html,
      format_date(a$date_modified)
    ))
  }
} else {
  cat('<div id="osf-error" style="text-align:center;padding:2rem 1rem;color:#666;',
      'background:#f8f9fa;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #dee2e6;">',
      '<p>Could not load projects from OSF.</p>',
      '<p><a href="https://osf.io/user/pgkjv" target="_blank" ',
      'style="color:#007BFF;">View my projects on OSF &#8594;</a></p></div>\n',
      sep = "")
}

cat('</div>\n')
```
